tasks.label: Back Up Practice Vehicle
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $source = '${workspaceFolder}/vehicle-restore-practice/vehicles.json'; $stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss-fff'; $destination = Join-Path 'D:\vehicle Manager Backup Lab' ('Practice-' + $stamp); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destination | Out-Null; $copy = Join-Path $destination 'vehicles.json'; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $source -Destination $copy; if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $source).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $copy).Hash) { throw 'Backup verification failed.' }; Write-Output ('Verified backup: ' + $copy)

tasks.label: Back Up Vehicle Manager Project
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $source = '${workspaceFolder}'; $drive = [IO.DriveInfo]::new('D:'); if (!$drive.IsReady -or $drive.VolumeLabel -ne 'kosbees') { throw 'Connect the kosbees backup drive as D:.' }; $destination = Join-Path 'D:\vehicle Manager Backup Lab' ('Project-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss-fff')); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destination | Out-Null; & robocopy.exe $source $destination /E /XJ /R:1 /W:1 /NFL /NDL /NP; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8) { throw ('Robocopy failed with exit code ' + $LASTEXITCODE) }; foreach ($name in @('vehicles.json', 'app.py', 'main.py', 'storage.py')) { if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $source $name)).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $destination $name)).Hash) { throw ('Backup verification failed for ' + $name) } }; Write-Output ('Project backup complete: ' + $destination); exit 0
